posts.text: If you're at Author Nation and planning your afternoon, don't miss "Building Direct Reader Relationships when Algorithms Are Unreliable," hosted by Mark Leslie Lefebvre at 2:30 pm in the Platinum Room!
Are you an author or publisher looking for a Podcast tailored to you? We've collected the episodes of our Self-Publishing Insiders Podcast into a YouTube playlist.
Author Nation attendees: join Megan Spann in the Platinum Room at 9am for "Beyond KU: Unlocking Library Distribution for Kindle Unlimited Authors!"
